_about: Other ways owners ask a checked question about a symptom (English and Taglish), for add_pet_profiles.py. Each is trained with that checked answer and its sources unchanged, so the symptom rules (src/lib/symptomNotes.js) have enough examples. Keys are ids in data/train.jsonl. Never put an evaluation question here (the script checks).
